title: Piplup — The First Bubble Ballet
description: A round, bright-eyed Piplup proudly raises one flipper on a sculpted ice floe. Its first Bubble attack becomes a descending necklace of crystalline globes above a leaping orange fish, framed by a curling, foam-tipped tide. A connected chamfered ocean plinth, webbed toes, a tiny tail, white cheek masks, sparkling eyes and the azure crown marking finish the scene on every side.
